candace jones.text: Candace was an amazing realtor. She poured so much effort into helping my partner and I find our perfect home. She is extremely knowledgeable about the area and the whole process, which took so much stress out of the process. On top of that she is a genuinely great person who was an absolute delight to work with. We cannot recommend Candace enough.

Candace is a uniquely exceptional real estate broker! She and Adrian have been helping my girlfriend and I to find our perfect home for almost two years - we have been extremely selective and particular as we had some very specific requirements for the house we were looking for, and despite the extremely long time we've been looking, Candace never grew frustrated with us and always treated us with kindness, patience, and good humor. You know you have a great broker when you can say "this one might not be the right house for us, but at least we get to see Candace today!

I sold my first home in Durham in July 2022 with Candace Jones. This being my first time working with a seller's agent, Candace set the bar for all subsequent seller's agents, and exceeded all my expectations - from her timely, clear, and thorough communication, to budget-appropriate recommendations for repairs and upgrades - Candace was professional and got the job done (and got me what I wanted!).

We didn't know what to expect from a realtor since we lived in our previous house for over 25 years. She gave great advice, allowed us to make our own choices without pressure and then fully supported our choices. She was quick to respond to any questions we had, even stopping by if she was in the neighborhood. Buying and selling a home can be stressful, but Candace made it less so with her friendly demeanor and professionalism. We highly recommend Inhabit Real Estate, especially Candace and Adrian.

Candace tirelessly worked with me to find a “very specific house” in a “very specific neighborhood” in a very tight housing market. I remember her getting on her hands and knees to get into a crawlspace one rainy Sunday morning to find out if there was water (there was). She is extremely knowledgeable of the Durham housing market and she is a skillful businesswoman. My husband and I were very impressed with the advice she gave us which ultimately led us to finding our dream house.

clara harrison.text: You're doing yourself a disservice by not asking for Clara to be your realtor. She was phenomenal from start to finish. She found me a home WAY under budget, saving me thousands, AND got a credit from the seller, despite it being an "as-is" sale. Clara is very straightforward and honest. She is in this profession because she loves her job and is passionate about helping people, which was apparent throughout the entire process. I had to have been one of her neediest clients, but she dealt with me nonetheless and never made me feel like my questions were silly. If not for her, I'd still be struggling to find the right house. CALL AND ASK FOR HER!!!!

Clara Harrison is a unicorn. She is professional in ways almost impossible to find, and down-to-earth friendly at the same time. She made the house-selling process not only exceedingly easy, but truly a pleasure. She always kept the big picture in mind—she has the keenest insight into the overall market—but she also had that same insight into the neighborhood level and the ins and outs of real estate transactions. Throughout the whole process, she attended to every tiny detail, always remaining cheerful and upbeat. Hire this unicorn, and you will soon congratulate yourself on a really great decision.

Just completed the sale of our Durham home. Clara Harrison was fantastic to work with! She knows the market and neighborhoods well, and works hard to make it happen. She regularly went well above and beyond to help us, since we are not local. I am a Real Estate Agent in Atlanta - so I see a lot of agents. Clara is one of the best. Importantly, she is also simply a joy to work with!

connie semans.text: “Connie Semans FAR exceeded our expectations ... she is conscious of everything while also demonstrating complete composure, reducing drama, working with facts, and simultaneously giving excellent advice.”

“Connie struck the perfect balance between listener and advisor, graciously leading us to the most informed decisions while leaving us feeling those decisions were ours. Her wise guidance, genteel manner, steely negotiating, and professional expertise helped us navigate a very difficult market for buyers and ultimately land our dream house. Without her, we might still be looking.”

After we moved out of state, Connie took care of everything: coordinating junk removal and donations, choosing paint colors, cleaning up the landscaping, and making design changes that made our house shine! Best of all, she facilitated and managed everything in record time. The house looked terrific and sold quickly at a price beyond our expectations. She relieved us of any burden related to selling our home from afar. We would choose to use her again in a second!"

dara shain.text: Dara was responsive, genuine, knowledgeable, and made us feel so comfortable with her warm and welcoming nature. She had the right mix of excitement, energy, responsibility, and guidance. Dara matched our energy perfectly, stayed responsive even when out of town, and connected us with great vendors for inspections and other services. She quickly understood what we were looking for in a home and consistently found and showed us properties within our price range that were a great fit. She guided us through closing flawlessly, making the entire experience smooth and enjoyable. We couldn't have asked for a better experience as young first-time homebuyers. We would 100% recommend her to anyone.

Dara isn’t just the best realtor I’ve ever worked with. She’s one of the best people I’ve worked with in any profession, hands down. Not just because she excels at every aspect of her job, but because her warmth and dedication shines through in everything she does. She leveraged her extensive network of professional and personal relationships on my behalf. And after she helped me find the perfect place, she stayed in touch long after closing to make sure I had everything I needed to get settled in, from roofers and plumbers to designers and landscapers. You’ll be glad you have her on your side.

Dara has helped me buy and sell a couple of houses now, and she is phenomenal! My favorite thing about working with Dara, aside from the wonderful results, is her genuineness. She is reliable, communicative, honest, kind, funny, down to earth, and brings herself to the process along with all of her sharp expertise. She never makes the client feel like they are work, and working with her always feels like a joy. I trust her completely and would highly recommend working with Dara.

We have bought and sold two houses with Dara and have had a seamless (and profitable!!) experience. She is so easy to work with, got us everything we wanted in the negotiations for both purchases, and got us multiple offers and two sales way above list price. While getting ready to list, her feedback was invaluable. She made what could be an extremely stressful transaction super easy by having everything we needed to do well organized and easy to get through. I recommend her to all my friends, and all have done well on both the buy and sell process! She's lived in Durham for a long time, and is an awesome resource on the area, neighborhoods, etc. Can't recommend her highly enough.

Dara is the realtor you need to represent you. She has now sold two houses for me in less than 12 months. I attribute every ounce of the success I’ve had to her hard work. She works tirelessly for her clients, and brings a degree of professionalism to the table that inspires others to meet her high standard. Across the board- her communication, transactional knowledge, network of colleagues and effervescent energy make her a delight to work with. If you want an ethical agent who will represent YOUR interests and no one else’s, call Dara ASAP.

eila voloshen.text: Eila was incredible; I want to buy/sell another home just so I can work with her again! She is extremely organized, responsive, and available. In this market, one has to be ready to go on showings at a moment's notice, and Eila always made it happen, which I'm sure involved rearranging her schedule. She even found listings before they officially hit the market by leveraging local networks. She texts and uses docusign, which was super convenient when trying to handle logistics while I was also working full time. The thing I loved about her the most was that she was always taking on the next step of the process, for example by scheduling inspections and giving me clear directions about what was needed from me. Everyone she recommended (lender, various inspectors, closing attorney) were also incredible. I went from offer to closing in under a month, including resolving issues in the inspection report, for which Eila's strategy definitely worked in my favor. Everything about the process was so easy with Eila. As a person, Eila is also very kind, a clear communicator, and supportive of non-traditional families.

Eila is a top notch real estate professional, with whom I’ve had the pleasure to work with for over a year and a half now. As an investor, one of the most critical components of any successful investment is to purchase the right property to align with your needs. When it comes to out of state investors, it is even more critical, as you usually don’t get to see or check the property in first hand, so you need to have someone local that you can fully trust, to check the place, take videos, consult and give advice, and be connected with the right professionals which can help prior and after the property purchase. Eila is that AND much more. The personal connection, the almost non-stop availability, and her ability to quickly understand your needs is unprecedented.

Eila Voloshen is the best thing that ever happened to me in my investment history, and I highly recommend her to anyone - from friends and family to total strangers who want to do real estate investments. Thank you Eila for all the hard work, and for doing everything with such a great spirit and love to what you do.

I worked with Eila Voloshen to sell a house and buy a house. She was fabulous in both processes, and found and helped me buy my dream house. She knows her stuff, and was highly responsive, reliable, and supportive throughout the process and beyond. She also has an excellent sense of style, knows the area, and has strong relationships with great service providers. I highly recommend her and her wonderful team.

Eila Voloshen goes above and beyond for her clients. She helped us get everything we wanted and for buyers in NC that’s not so easy! We closed on our first home in Raleigh, NC and we owe our happiness to Eila. Thank you.

Eila is seriously amazing. She helped me sell my last flip property. We had structural issues with the house and she still got my place to get an accepted offer with in a couple weeks of being on the market. She also helped us find a perfect home in the super competitive durham market. She is the best and definitely recommend her for any real estate projects!

elizabeth barry.text: Elizabeth was our buyer's agent for the purchase of our first home. She is absolutely fantastic and I wish I could give her 100 stars -- she truly goes above and beyond for her clients. She is incredibly knowledgeable about the entire home buying process and has a wonderful personality. She was a pleasure to work with, and when our offer was accepted on our new home I was a bit sad because it meant we wouldn't get to go look at houses together anymore! Elizabeth taught us so much about what to look for in a house, including the various potentially expensive problems houses can have and how to detect them. Elizabeth has a variety of strategies that helped us make a competitive offer on our home and is capable of helping people win offers even in this crazy market. We look forward to keeping in touch with Elizabeth and are so grateful to have had the opportunity to work with her! :-)

When my wife and I decided it was time to buy our first home we looked no further than the real estate expert that is Elizabeth Barry. At every showing, she conducted a thorough investigation of the status of the house and gave us an objective score based on her opinion. There were many things we didn’t know, and Elizabeth took the time to educate us, which really helped us interpret quality and inform our decisions. We appreciated her honest opinion, especially when she challenged our decision to settle for a house that wasn’t the perfect fit. This really opened my eyes to how invested she is in finding what’s EXACTLY right for her clients. I would recommend Elizabeth to anyone looking for a home. Frankly, I’m not sure there’s anyone better.

Elizabeth did an excellent job educating us on the selling process beforehand, handled everything quickly and communicated with us timely and to the point, leaving nothing unanswered. She set the right expectations for how much we could get and provided the right advice on what repairs/prep needed to be done and what we should not focus on. She even got into the crawl space to check if it was dry and had other issues herself, which most realtors probably never do. Professional and easy to work with, Elizabeth fulfilled all of our expectations and gave us the confidence that we ended up with the best outcome.

Why are you reading this? Pretty good chance that you are trying to find a good realtor and you want to know if Elizabeth Barry will be up for the task – you want to confirm that she is dependable, savvy about the business, and will put your interests first. If that’s all you need to know, read no further – she has all your needs covered. You need someone who really knows the local housing stock and can happily answer your ninth question, today. You need someone who is task-oriented and knows how to get offers accepted and close deals. Basically, YOU NEED SOMEONE WHO REALLY GETS AFTER IT! With all that, it would also be quite a bonus if you found someone who is naturally thoughtful, has a good sense of humor, and is enjoyable to be around. In all regards, Elizabeth still has you covered.

emma gould.text: “My wife and I would not have been able to buy a home if it was not for Emma's attentiveness, ingenuity, contacts, and experience. Emma put together a miracle in the eleventh hour and ran the show from start to finish. We will never be able to repay or thank her enough for the level of professionalism and care she has given to us. In today's market, it is a tall order to get a decent home and win an offer as a first-time buyer, so finding someone like Emma is the difference between moving into your first home or continuing your rental journey.”

“As a first-time home buyer I feel genuinely lucky we had a friend recommend Emma to us as an agent. She's super smart, very responsive, and helped provide us with guidance throughout the experience that made the process genuinely enjoyable.”

“Let me tell you about Emma Gould. She’s the most knowledgeable, dedicated, thoughtful, and thorough real estate professional I’ve ever worked with. She handled our late-night musings and fast-paced home-viewing schedule as if we were the only clients she had. She staged our home and got us multiple offers in record time, allowing us the opportunity to make a competitive offer on a home in our dream neighborhood simultaneously. What’s more - we’ve been in our home for over a year now, and she’s still an incredible neighbor, dropping off gifts over the holidays and handwritten notes to usher in the new year. I can’t say enough about how amazing it’s been to work with Emma! She leaves no stone unturned for her clients, and I’m certain she will work exceptionally hard to close the deal for you.”
Emma was outstanding in every phase of the home buying process. She was knowledgeable, organized, and went above and beyond with her effort. Fantastic experience.

I cannot recommend Emma highly enough! She was an absolute rockstar helping us navigate this crazy market as first time home buyers. She was flexible and responsive when it came to showings, and was super attentive to all of our needs and preferences (suggesting houses for us to view, pointing out features of houses that we might like/ not like). She answered all of our questions and was able to reach out to her (extensive!) network for anything that she did not know. She was never pushy, and I really appreciated her input on all the homes we viewed. She really went above and beyond to help us find a home. If you are looking for a realtor in the Durham area, go with Emma!

jamie bey.text: Jamie has been an absolute delight to work with. She is professional and very knowledgeable and will do everything in her power to make things work and to find a real home for you. From day one, I had the feeling that Jamie understood what I was looking for and I probably would not have bought a house had it not been for Jamie making everything so easy for me. She was always at least one step ahead of everyone else involved in the process, be that the lending office, the HOA, or another company for additional inspections. If you want things done right and with the least amount of stress in the process, Jamie is your best bet!

Jamie is the best! She was thorough, professional, knowledgeable, great to work with, and a genuine person who cares about her clients. She kept us up-to-date about available appointments, always let us know if something had changed, and advised us on the property before even seeing it. She was honest and forthright, no games. We are so lucky to have found Jamie and would recommend her to anyone!

Cannot emphasize enough how helpful, kind, and communicative Jamie has been every step of the way during our homebuying journey. As first-time homebuyers with minimal knowledge of buying a home, we are so pleased and grateful for her expertise, determination to help us win offers, and timeliness to fulfill the steps required of us. Not only did we get our first offer accepted on our house thanks to her hard work and help, but she also noticed the little details about what we love in a home and the small touches that were important to us (helping us find the right spot for us and our pet cat)! Trust me, the process will be smooth and wonderful with Jamie’s help. We’re very glad to know her, in and out of working together, and we cannot recommend her enough!

We have bought and sold many properties in many different places over the years. Jamie provided the best service of any Realtor we have ever used. Her communication skills are superb, and she followed up immediately on any and all requests we made. We set extremely high standards for the folks who represent us in our real estate transactions. This is the first time that an agent has EXCEEDED those expectations. Jamie is HIGHLY recommended.

We loved working with Jamie! She's both professional and friendly, and a delight all around. We were first-time homebuyers, so the process was completely new to us. She explained everything well and was very patient with us. She was a rockstar in helping us navigate the housing market, especially at our lower price point, and she was so attentive to us that she made us feel like we were her only clients.

jennifer teel.text: Jennifer helped us buy our first home in a neighborhood we didn't think we could afford. Thanks to her proactive attitude and her availability, we were able to submit our offer the same weekend we saw the house. She was patient with us as we figured out what we wanted, and it led to a great match. Thanks, Jennifer!

Jennifer was a huge help from start to finish! We could go to her with any questions and was always able to help. She was always willing to look at any property at anytime and it was a joy to work with her. I would recommend her to any one and I will definitely be working with her again in the future.

It was a pleasure working with Jennifer. We met her at an open house and after discussing our interests she only showed us properties which matched our requirements and was low key and not pushy at all.

Jen is an outstanding agent known for her expertise and dedication. She consistently demonstrates exceptional teamwork, fostering collaboration and open communication. Her commitment to achieving the best client outcomes makes her a valuable asset to any brokerage.

jenny barrier.text: Jenny Brugnolotti Barrier is an incredible real estate agent. We were so lucky to find her. We are Canadians and were house hunting from across the border, and needed someone we could trust to understand what we wanted, who was available and willing to check out properties in detail on our behalf, and who could help us within a very tight timeframe of just a couple of months. We contacted several other agents before Jenny was recommended to us, and she put all of them to shame immediately.

Getting to work with Jenny made the entire process absolutely incredible. She was a wise companion offering vast knowledge about the local market in Durham, while also helping me appreciate what it means to be a good steward of our home. She has great taste, but never pressured me and my husband. She wanted to be sure we were well within our price range, and was patient as we waited for the right home. She was consistently timely in her communication, personable but professional, and offered great strategy as we navigated a competitive market in Durham. Once we were under contract, Jenny was a fierce advocate, helping us negotiate fairly but firmly. It was a true joy to work with Jenny, I would recommend her again and again!

Jenny Barrier has represented us as seller and buyer. In both capacities she has exceeded our expectations, consistently going above and beyond the requirements of her job...Finally, let us add that Jenny is not only an extremely talented realtor but also a compassionate person. She does an excellent job of balancing the two, never crossing the professional boundary but always showing that she cares about her clients. We cannot recommend her highly enough.

My husband and I were first-time homebuyers and felt safe and understood in Jenny's care. Jenny patiently and thoroughly answered all of our questions, and we never felt pressured to make decisions outside of our comfort, which is critical when the home-buying process can move so quickly. She is incredibly knowledgeable about real estate and homes in the Triangle, and she inspects homes thoroughly and skillfully. Jenny played a vital role in my husband and me finding our perfect home. We are so happy and grateful to have Jenny in our lives. She is a genuinely kind person and a one-of-a-kind realtor who you want in your corner!

jessica youngblood.text: Jessica was beyond amazing throughout our whole house-buying experience. She was knowledgeable, thoughtful, and communicative. Highly recommend.
She is incredibly kind, warm, personable, and very communicative. Her love and passion for her work is so clear and comes through in every interaction. I highly recommend working with Jessica!!

I had the pleasure of working with Jessica and to say I was so highly impressed is an understatement. Her attention to detail, communication and written skills, knowledge of the market, and overall pleasant personality will take her to new heights in her real estate business.
For a young agent in the real estate business, Jessica did a fantastic job!

justine oller.text: Justine was amazing. She was very attentive and available throughout the process and she was super knowledgeable about the area and the industry. I would absolutely hire her again in the future!

We had a fabulous experience with Inhabit and working with Justine on the purchase of our first home. She was willing to meet with us even when we weren't ready to actively search and still made us feel valued/listened to. We ended up buying our first home about 8 months later. She was knowledgeable about the process, area, and we always felt like we were in good hands. Also as a bonus, Justine was extremely personable and we always had a great time with her!

I can’t say enough about how incredible Justine was to work with. She was extremely proactive, responsive, and supportive throughout the home sale process. As a first time home seller navigating a challenging market, Justine made me feel cared for and treated the sale of my home as though it was her own property. Zillow needs to add a sixth star so I can rate her appropriately.

katelin walpole.text: I can't say enough about Katelin Walpole. I have worked with six realtors before Katelin, and none of them come close to what she offers. About three years in the process my offer was accepted. Unfortunately, an unusual issue popped up that not many people knew how to deal with. Katelin took that as a challenge and ran with it, getting information from a ton of different resources. She found a solution, and now I am typing this review from my new house. If you want a realtor that is tenacious, patient, knowledgeable, trustworthy and a bit of a workaholic (I had to refrain from sending her messages late because I knew she would answer them asap) then Katelin is your realtor. I have zero reservations recommending her. She sets the bar high.

Katelin was incredible to work with throughout my house search and homebuying process! She provided sound advice and expert guidance to help ease the stress of every decision I was faced with along the way. I was really pleased with the purchase price and all the specifics of the contract that Katelin helped me to negotiate. Katelin's keen knowledge of home construction and home maintenance really set her apart, and she's truly able to give expert advice in that realm...For instance, she came up with a brilliant renovation solution to relocate the laundry room in my new home to make it much more convenient and functional, which the contractor she recommended was then able to carry out.

I honestly don't think I could've gone through this process without Katelin's help. You have to have so much trust in your realtor when buying a house and I never once doubted trusting her. She was upfront and honest with me and was patient in guiding me through the whole process. My house was in high competition, and with her advice I was able to win the bid in my budget! She was so knowledgeable about the market, home and neighborhoods and immediately knew what I was looking for before I even did! Highly recommend!

Katelin was awesome. She practically held my hand through this whole process. Moments when I would get uncomfortable with the thought of purchasing a home, she always could pick up on those vibes and would say something that would make me feel better about my decision. She always answered my calls and texts no matter how early or late. We were together so much looking at houses that she became like a little sister to me. I would recommend Katelin hands up if you need not just a realtor but a friend. I don't know what I would have done if she was not so generous, patient and loving as she was. Thanking you Katelin for making this transition one of the best experiences of a lifetime.

Katelin helped my fiance & I find our dream home!! She was wonderful & enthusiastic. We felt we could trust her & she helped to guide us in the process of making the biggest decision for our family of 6. She was always there for us & answered every question we could think of! We can't thank her enough for her patience with us through the whole process!

katie dinsmore.text: Katie helped me buy a home a few years ago, then she was the listing agent when I sold my home in Duke Forest. She did a great deal of market research, presented it to us thoughtfully, and priced it perfectly! We choose Katie primarily because of her strong interpersonal skills and diplomacy with other realtors. The home sold in less than a week for almost 10% over list price, while other very similar homes in our neighborhood sat on the market for a couple of months because they were overpriced, then sold for the same as our home (even though they were slightly bigger and probably nicer.) She really made the process of selling pretty low-stress.

I can't say enough good things about Katie. As my seller's agent, she helped me stage my house, provided reliable contacts for fixing it up, and coordinated three open houses in one weekend with no snags. She kept me grounded when I was feeling anxious, encouraging me throughout the process. Once offers started coming in, she dealt with difficult buyer's agents with kindness while still standing her ground and working in our best interest. Throughout various negotiations, she had great insights on the options we had, and she always responded to the other agent in a way that was strong and direct without being mean. She was always available when we needed her, and was never annoyed with all of my questions. I'd wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone.

Katie told us on Day One that she was in it with us for the long haul because nothing was more important to her than helping us find the house we both loved. Katie was always incredibly responsive, patient, flexible, and understanding, especially as we considered making offers on houses we had seen but ultimately decided to keep looking. She is a careful listener and delivers on the wants and needs of her clients. When a house we were very interested in came up as “Coming Soon,” Katie monitored the status of the listing and worked with the seller’s agent to get us one of the first showings. My wife and I highly recommend Katie and know you will enjoy working with her as well.

liz dean.text: Liz Dean is Excellent - A lot of agents don't provide the value that I would expect, but Liz had both a breadth and depth of knowledge about the area, landscaping, construction materials, and so on that saved us a lot of headaches.

I wish I could give Liz 100 stars! In 2020, my husband and I decided to move to Durham from Vermont. It was the height of the pandemic and we didn't know anyone. A friend recommended Liz and we're so grateful she did. Liz is the reason we continue to be so happy here 4 years later. We never thought we'd be the type of people to buy a home virtually, but with Liz, it felt normal. We built trust and rapport easily. She knows the area since she's lived here all her life. She's funny, down to earth, and highly knowledgeable about everything inside and outside a house. She's truly the swiss army knife of real estate. She's a general contractor, house inspector, interior decorator, arborist, and real estate pro all in one! She also has incredible relationships with sellers agents and we're convinced her offer advice was the reason why we were able to get the winning bid. If you're looking for a real estate agent that will have your back, go with Liz. You'll be glad you did!

Liz helped me buy my first house over six years ago. She walked me through the process, explained everything to me, and held my hand all along the way. Six years later I still call her if I need advice for anything to do with my house including landscaping, repairs, and upgrades. I have recommended her to several friends and they have had the same experience. I am now getting ready to sell my house and again Liz is by my side, helping me through the process. You won't find a better person to help you buy or sell a home.

I have to second Liz Dean! She came as a referral from another friend and was wonderful to work with. Bought early this year, and she couldn’t have worked harder for us. She’s lived here in Durham forever and really knows the ins and outs of the area.
We had a fabulous experience with Liz Dean at Inhabit. She not only got us our dream home during peak market madness, but has been so helpful in suggesting excellent contractors as things come up.

Her dedication to the task was above what I had expected and went well above the call of duty. Besides taking me around multiple times to some of the same houses, She was honest with her advice and did not steer me into too much house or more expensive price ranges, just to benefit herself. She really cared about what would best suit me. I wound up in a house that is perfect for me.

marie brockenbrough.text: “As first-time home buyers, we were grateful for Marie's expertise, support, and guidance throughout the entire process. Marie not only appreciates the historic charm and beautiful architecture in the Durham area but also understands the nuances of each neighborhood. Marie took the time to get to know us and our preferences, ensuring that she showed us properties that aligned with our vision. Marie's extensive network of top-tier vendors streamlined the process, making it easier for us to navigate the complexities of home buying. Overall, we cannot recommend Marie highly enough.”

“10/10 recommend Marie to anyone looking to buy or sell in the Triangle, and especially Durham. As a Durham native, she really understands the local market, and she has an impeccable eye for quality and design. But more importantly, she really cares about each of her clients’ needs/wants and keeps those front and center for the entire buying and/or selling process. Recently, she helped us find and make the winning offer on the perfect home for our family, and then turned around and got our old house under contract (now sold!) with an offer that was beyond our wildest hopes. We continue to feel like we hit the jackpot with Marie as our realtor. She knows what she’s doing, and she does it with love!”

“I don't know where to start. There are so many great things about Marie! As a first time home buyer I felt MORE than taken care of in Marie's hands. She went out of her way to make herself available to me for showings- even around the holiday season. She never left any task undone or any question unanswered. I can say for certain I would not be in my new home if it were not for Marie. Even after moving in she has been a sounding board for recommendations of all kinds. Marie is a true gem - don't pass up the opportunity to work with the best!”

Recently we decided to sell our house of 35 years and move to another city. We were pessimistic about selling – unnerved over the decisions in updating and repairing our current home, and very uncomfortable with the ROI and ultimate value. We would be far away through all of this, having to delegate the work and decisions. We chose Marie for her track record, her professionalism, her realistic and honest discussions with us, her vision for innovative approaches to marketing, and for her empathy for the pressures we were under. The Realtor and the person together made it an easy choice.

“I was scared about the home-buying process until we met Marie. Not only is Marie extremely knowledgeable and responsive, but she also genuinely cares about (and seems to really enjoy) her job, which makes all of the difference. Marie met us with expertise, patience, and enthusiasm, and helped us immensely in navigating this wild market. It meant the world that we could go about this process with confidence, knowing that I could trust Marie's input and that Marie "got" us. I could not have asked for a better experience.”

meredith pope.text: Meredith was AWESOME! My wife and I are research scientists/engineers, so we like to have all the facts and like to listen to professional opinions on things before making decisions. We also were not about to throw down all of our money with a hope and prayer of our offer being accepted. We wanted to ensure we were still getting our money's worth, despite a terrible housing market for buyers. Meredith DELIVERED! She hunted down as many documents and as much information as she could find and sent it our way. She walked us through the docs, and gave an idea of how she would use that information to inform her decisions if she was the buyer. We really felt Meredith had our back and took the time to understand our situation so we could find a house that fit our wants and needs. She wasn't just trying to make a sale, she was trying to help us find our dream home.

Meredith was a fabulous realtor. She was interested in so much more than "selling a house." First, she found good properties for us based on our needs and desires. She also encouraged us to wait for the right home, and to carefully evaluate each property and see ourselves living there. At the same time, Meredith knew that expediency was necessary in such a hot market, so once we expressed interest, she moved very quickly to ask questions of the seller and to address potential issues. She even visited neighbors when she couldn't get the information we wanted any other way.

Meredith is truly amazing! Not only is she so nice to work with (in this market, you spend a lot of time talking/working with your realtor, so it's definitely important to like them!), but she really knows her stuff! She was so responsive and always had the best recommendations. She also is so willing to work with your schedule in order to go to all the viewings. The market right now is crazy and she never lost hope and always was a positive reminder that the perfect house was still out there, and she ultimately helped me find that! I cannot recommend Meredith enough, and I will definitely be using her again if I am ever looking for another house!

Meredith is a fantastic realtor and I would highly recommend her! She was very diligent and easy to work with, especially when buying in a hot market. Meredith is really knowledgeable about the RTP area and will work at your pace and give you the information you need to make a decision. Furthermore, she is very responsive via email and text, which was really important to me when buying from further away. She was always prepared when showing us homes, tracked down answers to our questions quickly, and even helped us coordinate renovation estimates before we closed. She went above and beyond for us and it was the best experience buying we've had. We will absolutely work with her again!

natalie shaw.text: We feel very fortunate to have found Natalie to assist in the sale of our property in Chapel Hill…. She advised us on what needed to be done (and not done) to get the best return on our investment. Natalie lined up an array of excellent contractors to knock out the work and oversaw the entire process….Natalie communicated well throughout the process to keep all parties informed and the process moving forward seamlessly. If you're looking for a great Realtor who knows the area well and exceeds expectations, look no further.

Natalie was amazingly patient and wonderful throughout our unconventional home-buying process. Our unique situation created many complications and delays, but she was always ready to receive us where we were and quickly yet carefully direct every step. Any stress we caused never showed, and it felt like we were held in a sincere smile of gracious support and clear-headed business all the way through. I would recommend working with her absolutely for any home-buying process.

Working with Natalie was a great experience. I felt like I was in good hands throughout the entire process. She was incredibly communicative, considerate of my needs and thoughts, and guided me through the process of selling my home with clarity and expertise. All I had to do was follow her lead and I ended up selling my home for far more than I had ever anticipated. Additionally, she is a lovely woman with a truly kind heart. I absolutely recommend working with her and plan to if I ever need help buying or selling a home in the future.

Natalie was AWESOME! From the first phone call to even now after buying our first home she was always incredibly responsive, timely, and helpful on our home-buying journey. She has incredible experience, passion, and knowledge of the entire housing industry and we always felt like we were in great hands. She will make sure that the home that you are buying and or looking for fits your needs perfectly. If you do one tour of a home you will know immediately that she knows her stuff. Every detail matters to her and it helped us create a competitive offer for our first home. She was great to work with in my wife and I’s differing schedules and was always so patient with us.

Natalie was incredibly helpful in selling my house. She helped to identify what repairs and improvements were needed before my house went on the market and was able to clearly explain the market trends and the pros and cons of offers. I trusted Natalie to advise me on the process and always felt she was looking out for my best interests. Her knowledge of the area is extensive and her honesty and integrity make her someone I would turn to the next time I need a realtor.

paula hoge.text: Paula is a knowledgeable and experienced real estate agent with lots of heart and integrity. She knows the community inside out, listens to what her clients need, and is honest and straightforward. She's the kind of person people come back to 20 years after first working with her because they trust her. She gives you her full attention and values each individual client and family she works with.

If you want to sell your house in Chapel Hill quickly and for a great price, we highly recommend you hire Paula Hoge as your agent. From the first preliminary discussions right through the closing on the sale of our home, Paula took great care of us. She is the complete package: 20+ years of experience, great local knowledge, superior communication, top-notch marketing skills and just tremendous savvy about the entire process.

One of the best things about working with Paula was access to her wonderful team of local business people who in a few short weeks managed to repair, re-finish, re-furbish and stage our 25 year old house to make it sparkling inside and out and allowed us to compete favorably with new construction and much newer existing homes. Paula masterfully orchestrated all the details of the process and the transformation was stunning! We were under contract within a few days and closed in 3 weeks, all thanks to Paula. We will forever be grateful, as we simply could not have done it without her!

We cannot recommend enough Paula Hoge as a real estate agent. We have been working with Paula for a number of years. She first helped us buy investment properties. We were new to this type of deals and Paula walked us through the entire process from finding good properties in areas with appreciation potential to finalizing the closings. Paula was present at every step of the transactions and her input was invaluable. When we decided to build our home we again worked with Paula. She listened to our needs and wishes, helped us find a community, and connected us to the right people to build our house.

When the time came to sell our investment properties and our house, we relied heavily on Paula, as we were hundreds of miles away. Paula made sure the houses were ready for the sale and she stepped up for us since we could not be on site. She sold our properties in a matter of weeks. Paula’s knowledge of the Chapel Hill area is amazing. She analyzes the trends, gives an honest assessment of properties, and has a strong network of professionals to help with the transactions. More importantly, Paula cares for her clients. Based on our experience we recommended Paula to friends and family including our children!

shelby bishop.text: Shelby helped us purchase a home in a fast-moving housing market. She was incredibly professional, efficient, and supportive throughout the process as well as a great resource for finding contractors for various home improvements. She is fantastic to work with and would be my first stop for future real estate needs.

We had the pleasure of working with Shelby Bishop on our recent home purchase and can't recommend her enough. She cooperated with us for several months while we worked out our relocation back to Chapel Hill, and when we found the right place, she was extremely engaged, insightful and supportive. Most importantly, she kept the process stress-free! She was a true partner and a wonderful person to work with.

Responsive. Friendly. Knowledgeable. And extremely patient! As a first-time homebuyer, I had a lot of questions, and Shelby was the perfect agent for me. She was organized and helped me close on my house in just 30 days. I also appreciated her ability to have sometimes challenging conversations with me about getting realistic on the market and my spending capacity. Shelby is also LGBTQ+ friendly and sensitive to issues of race, both of which were crucial to us. 10/10 highly recommend!

stephanie ross.text: Stephanie has been such a pleasure to work with in finding our dream Durham home…We are also very appreciative of the way she walked us through the home-buying process. Having purchased our last home more than 25 years ago, there were times when we were a little overwhelmed. We always felt comfortable emailing/texting with questions and/or requests for information about particular homes…Stephanie will definitely be our realtor of choice when offering recommendations! Not only is she knowledgeable about reality, but she knows the community and she is absolutely lovely!

We thoroughly enjoyed working with Stephanie throughout the home-buying process. She is incredibly knowledgeable, easy to be with, personable, and always available to answer any questions. We unfortunately didn’t know exactly what we were looking for when we started, but Stephanie was so patient with us. When we found our home she was ready to take us through the process as quickly and painlessly as possible. Without a doubt, we recommend Stephanie very highly.

Stephanie went above and beyond to help my husband and I buy our first home!! Before we worked with her, we had ZERO idea what the home buying process was like and were completely overwhelmed. From day one, she answered all questions, responded quickly, kept us organized, and made us feel reassured and calm about each decision. She felt more like a friend throughout the whole process, giving us her professional opinion when we needed it and checking in to see if we had any lingering questions/concerns/feelings. I could go on and on because she was just that fantastic!! I'm so relieved and happy we found our home but I will definitely miss talking and working with Stephanie daily! :)

Oh boy, what an absolute treat it was to work with Stephanie. She is thoughtful, relatable, and hysterical, and I feel as though she treated me as a friend first, and a client secondly. The process of buying a home is oftentimes intimidating and feels impossible. Fortunately working with her, I was so cared for and heard by this FABULOUS human. I feel eternally lucky that going through tours, paperwork, underwriting, contracts and so forth was made peaceful, enjoyable and genuinely fun. Her guidance and knowledge was invaluable and I would HIGHLY recommend her.

I do not have enough space in this review to communicate how wonderful it was to work with Stephanie in purchasing my first home! I 100% believe she is the reason I was able to secure a home during an incredibly challenging buyer's market and I attribute this not only to her savviness in real estate, but her thoughtful approach, commitment to her clients, and incredible interpersonal skills.

sue fox.text: Sue was amazing to work with! A friend had bought her house with Sue and highly recommended her. Sue was so knowledgeable about negotiations, local inspectors, and the whole process. She was so fast in all of her work and replies. We're so excited for our house, and we'll definitely work with her again in the future if we ever buy again.

I'm in my late twenties and am a first-time home buyer. Sue handled all my questions professionally, kindly, and quickly, and I asked a lot of questions! She gave me honest and wise advice about placing a bid. I feel that Sue truly had my best interest at heart. She revealed that even more through helping me with my questions after I bought my home. I still feel free to talk with her, which speaks to her power of actually building a relationship with her clients. People may consider buying a home a stressful experience, but I can honestly say that mine was not…I am extremely grateful for Sue!

We called several realtors in the Chapel Hill Durham market and Sue Fox was by far the most responsive and knowledgeable about the sales in the area. We do not live in North Carolina and we relied heavily on Sue to help us get it ready for sale. She was an active participant in the sale of this property and she was creative and extremely pleasant. She has a team of folks who prepped the home so quickly and expertly that the home had an excellent offer 12 hours after her listing and were able to close three weeks later! Thanks so much Sue!

Recently located from out of state to the Durham area. I have never been a big fan of "buyer's agents" thinking they just want to make any deal they can just like most realtors. I was wrong, Sue not only found qualified homes to view that matched our criteria but brought a wealth of knowledge about the various areas and neighborhoods in the Raleigh-Durham-Chapel Hill area making the whole process easier. I would absolutely recommend Sue to anyone looking to buy or sell a house.

As a first-time home buyer, I had several questions and needed much guidance in the home buying process. I am so glad to have Sue as a real estate agent. She was very responsive and communicated with me every step of the way. Sue was able to get me contact information for a great lender, inspector, and attorney for closing. Sue was able to negotiate well on my behalf and walked me through her thoughts and reasoning behind her actions. Even after we closed on the house, she was still working to ensure every piece was just right. Thank you, Sue!
